decision_and_scoring.exact_reference: independent domain exact solve on realized scenario, used as a post-selection reference only
decision_and_scoring.plan_score: sum forecast route travel cost + predicted probability * sum contractual penalties for each selected route (one-minute horizon)
primary_metrics: per-scenario regret versus exact realized reference
decision_and_scoring.replicate_analysis: report each replicate mean and paired per-scenario method-minus-logistic objective differences; summarize mean, sample SD and range across 5 replicate means
decision_and_scoring.validator: backend.validator.validate_plan recomputes constraints and objective from realized input

information_boundary.common_random_numbers: all methods evaluated on identical frozen validation/test scenario group IDs and matrices per replicate
model_features: forecast route travel cost / 30 clipped to [0,1]
information_boundary.training_labels: train-only indicator that any route stop is late in the separately generated realized matrix, irrespective of penalty
